faq.question: Why do review cards often suit salons and spas well?
faq.answer: They often suit salons and spas because the card can feel more premium and intentional, which matches brand positioning better than a low-cost improvised sign.

faq.question: Should salons test static prompts as well as hand-delivered cards?
faq.answer: Yes. Many teams learn the most by testing one staff-delivered prompt and one static prompt in the same location before scaling a format chain-wide.
